description: 방송미디어통신위원회_해외 OTT 이용행태조사 정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 방송미디어통신위원회. 국내OTT 사업자의 성공적 해외 진출을 위하여 해외 진출 대상 국가의 현지 소비자를 대상으로 해외 OTT 이용행태를 조사, 분석한 정보 (파일저장안내: 왼쪽 메뉴의 해외 OTT 이용행태조사 나라(연도)별 클릭 가장 자주 시청하는 OTT 서비스 1순위 등 메뉴 클릭하여 xls, csv 등 원하는 파일... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 방송미디어통신위원회. Its tags are 해외OTT, 이용행태, 해외진출, 구독, 플랫폼. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-05-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
